design_principles: Every lesson has a communicative can-do outcome.
High-frequency vocabulary and curated topic vocabulary are separate curriculum streams.
Useful expressions and sentence frames are taught as first-class targets.
Grammar is introduced in service of communicative tasks and recycled later.
New material is deliberately recycled across later lessons and section checkpoints.
All four skills are tracked, while receptive and highly controlled production tasks dominate early A1.1.
